purpose: Historical preservation of closed, unmerged PR #108; owner-authorized abandoned experiment cleanup
owner_disposition: PR #108 was abandoned for artistic reasons, not because of a demonstrated technical or performance failure. The owner found that individually placed debris did not complement the approved crashed ship as intended. The artwork remains potentially useful for future environments or storytelling.

pr_snapshot.body:
Adds six small, independently adjustable debris props near the damaged rear engines using six regions of one owner-approved atlas. Each prop has a compact convex grounded collision on the existing solid-body and construction-blocker layers. No salvage, interactions, drops or gameplay scripts are added.

Preserves all nine supplied package files byte-for-byte, with exact-path Git attributes to retain the original README/manifest bytes. README records provenance, atlas regions, initial transforms and alpha-derived sizes, collision behavior and validation limits. Ship artwork/registration/scale, its collisions, accepted 2x-alpha shadow, hatch/spawn, camera, terrain and factory systems remain unchanged. PR #107 ground treatment is not restored.

Validation at 2e37fbfaaf12ae8faa4e1803396e097d1b68a76b: three focused non-native static tests PASS (`python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p static_ship_debris_test.py -v`); PNG hashes/CRCs/dimensions/transparency and atlas pixel correspondence PASS; all nine staged package blobs match the original ZIP; resource/Markdown references and diff whitespace PASS. Geometry checks preserve margins around the hatch/spawn corridor, Ferrite bounds, example starter construction area and current ship collisions. Existing 45 untracked owner files retain their baseline content hashes; ignored material was not touched. Tracked working tree is clean after commit.

Keep draft for owner-controlled graphical playtesting. Placement, collision fit, occlusion and readability at gameplay zoom remain provisional; the existing ship Y-sorting limitation remains deferred. No Godot launch, headless import, runtime test, graphical verification or benchmark was performed. No merge or cleanup is requested.
